## da776131ac9a

**Finding type: reproduced generator defect.** Generator SHA-256
`a945dae6355bec444ed544c8b0fc9b813af952c5dc9059f52d756aa093f59048`;
canonical rule hash `d473515e420b`.

At seed 7, sample index 0, overrides `grid_n=2, texture="full_grid"`, the
advertised exact texture returns `[[9,9],[9,0]]` (`nz=3`, `z=1`). The generator's
own `self_check` rejects it because `nz` must be at most `n²-2` and `z<=1` makes
the rule identity. Canonical Racket execution confirms that the output is the
same 2×2 grid. Thus an advertised texture deterministically emits an unlawful,
non-teaching identity instance.

This input is produced by the target generator but outside its documented valid
domain according to its own validator. No audit-target file was changed.

Evidence: `checks/audit-da776131ac9a-generator-diagnostic.json`,
`checks/audit-da776131ac9a-input.json`, and
`checks/audit-da776131ac9a-authority.json`.

## da776131ac9a

**Finding type: reproduced exact-override defect.** Generator SHA-256
`a945dae6355bec444ed544c8b0fc9b813af952c5dc9059f52d756aa093f59048`;
executed canonical rule hash `d473515e420b`.

At seed `0`, sample index `0`, difficulty `medium`, the joint overrides
`grid_n=3`, `nz=1`, `palette_size=1`, `palette_kind="small"`,
`cell_layout="scattered"`, `position_bias="spread"`, and
`anchor_corner=true` produce two nonzero cells, not the requested one. With the
same draw and `anchor_corner=false`, the grid has exactly one nonzero cell. The
cause is source-level and reproducible: the generator selects `nz` cells first,
then unconditionally paints `(0,0)` when the anchor is enabled; if that corner was
not selected, the exact count increases.

The generated two-cell input is accepted by the target's `self_check`, so the
failure is not filtered. Canonical Racket execution gives a `21×21` output
because the realized zero count is 7. A contract-respecting one-cell anchored
input gives a `24×24` output because the requested zero count is 8. Thus the
mismatch changes the task transformation, not only metadata.

Evidence: `checks/audit/da776131ac9a/probe.json`,
`checks/audit/da776131ac9a/counterexample.json`,
`checks/audit/da776131ac9a/racket.json`, and
`checks/audit/da776131ac9a/contract_respecting_racket.json`. The input is
produced by the target and accepted by its validator, but it violates the
advertised exact joint override. No audit-target source was changed.
